description: This script extracts custom error definitions from database engine specification files in the Superset project, parsing Python classes to identify error mappings for documentation purposes.

methods.name: extract_custom_errors_from_file
methods.description: Parses a Python engine spec file to extract custom error definitions from classes.

methods.name: extract_errors_from_dict
methods.description: Extracts error information from a custom_errors dictionary AST node.

methods.name: extract_error_tuple_info
methods.description: Extracts detailed error info from a tuple containing message, error type, and extra data.

methods.name: extract_string_from_call
methods.description: Retrieves string content from translation call nodes.

methods.name: extract_regex_info
methods.description: Extracts regex pattern or name from AST nodes.

methods.name: extract_invalid_fields
methods.description: Extracts list of invalid fields from an extra dictionary node.
